rationale: The workflow already implements the evidence-supported optimizations that fit it: dependency caching is present via `actions/setup-node` with `cache: npm` plus `npm ci` (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE); superseded-run cancellation is present via `concurrency` with `cancel-in-progress: true` grouped by PR number/ref (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE); and a custom job timeout is already bound at `timeout-minutes: 15` (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT). The remaining patterns do not apply or are unsafe here: there is no matrix, so P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is not applicable; there is no schedule, so P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE and P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE do not apply; there is no Bazel build, so the Bazel patterns are irrelevant. Change filtering (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER) and test selection/prioritization (P-LIT-SELECT, P-LIT-PRIORITIZE) carry contraindications or require separately approved selection treatment and would risk reducing the Ant Design CLI doctor/lint/usage coverage. Environment reuse (P-LIT-ENV-CACHE) is contraindicated by mutable dependency resolution. No additional supported, safe optimization is available, so the workflow is left unchanged to preserve intended build and test coverage.
